name: Camille Moreau
title: QA Automation Engineer
summary: Mid-level QA Automation Engineer with 6+ years of experience improving test coverage and release confidence across web and API platforms. Strong background in automation strategy, CI/CD integration, and collaborative quality practices within Agile teams, with a focus on maintainable frameworks and fast feedback loops.

bullets: Expanded automated regression coverage from 38% to 72% for a customer-facing web platform, reducing smoke test execution time by 65%.
Built and maintained end-to-end test suites in Cypress and Playwright, cutting escaped defects in production by 30% over 12 months.
Integrated automated checks into GitLab CI pipelines for 8 microservices, enabling quality feedback within 15 minutes of each merge request.
Partnered with developers and product owners in Agile ceremonies to define acceptance criteria and improve testability of new features.
Designed and implemented API and UI automation for a banking application, increasing repeatable test execution from 120 to 520 scenarios per release.
Created and maintained reusable test data sets and environment checks, which reduced false failures by 40%.
Executed risk-based testing for quarterly releases and coordinated defect triage across 4 cross-functional squads.
Reported quality metrics and test progress to stakeholders, helping improve release predictability by 20%.
Supported manual and automated testing for a healthcare SaaS product used by over 300 client sites.
Authored over 150 test cases and 60 automated regression checks for critical workflows.
Validated bug fixes and performed cross-browser testing across Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, improving defect detection before UAT by 25%.
Collaborated with support and development teams to reproduce customer issues and accelerate resolution times.
Assisted with functional testing of an internal web portal and documented defects in JIRA.
Prepared test execution evidence and helped standardize QA documentation for the team.
Participated in exploratory testing sessions that identified 18 usability and workflow issues before release.
